sections.title: Restoration and reconstruction
sections.subtitle: One company, several connected stages of recovery.
paragraphs: GCPRO Restoration is a locally owned and operated family business based in Lombard, Illinois. Our work includes water damage restoration, fire and smoke cleanup, mold remediation, contents cleaning and reconstruction for residential and commercial properties.

A damaged building can need more than one type of work. Water removal and drying address different problems from rebuilding walls and finishes. Personal belongings may need attention alongside the structure. Our service pages explain these separate scopes so you can identify the information relevant to your property.

sections.title: See the work
sections.subtitle: Project photographs provide a concrete starting point.
paragraphs: Our project collection includes water damage restoration in Glenview, fire damage restoration in Tinley Park and attic mold removal in Lombard. The before-and-after views show the documented changes at those properties.

Use the examples to understand the type of work shown, then tell us about your own building and the damage you can see. Photographs from another project do not establish the scope, schedule or outcome for yours.

sections.subtitle: Start with your property and the help you need.
paragraphs: Our office is at 220 Eisenhower Lane North, Lombard, IL 60148. Call 847-656-3322 for restoration assistance or use Contact Us for general questions and business inquiries.

When requesting service, include the property city or ZIP code, your contact information and a short description of the damage. For a business or managed property, identify the person who can discuss access and the proposed work.

Board-up addresses damaged openings, while odor removal concerns persistent odors and their source. These pages explain the tasks separately so you can ask more precise questions about the work needed.
